claims.statement: Management states that the company will not earn a margin of more than 15% or thereabouts.
claims.quote: We are very clear, we'll not earn more than 15% or thereabouts.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: DMart employee attrition has fallen from 13.9% to 11.3%.
facts.quote: DMart employee attrition actually has fallen from last year, which we have published, I think it's fallen by almost 2% to 3%, from 13.9% to 11.3%.

facts.statement: All DMart stores more or less hover around 40,000 square feet.
facts.quote: All our stores more or less hover around 40,000 square feet. And we will continue to be around that space.
